prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1041; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for side impact collision at intersection. Insured vehicle was proceeding through green signal when a second vehicle entered from cross street. Initial contact to driver side rear quarter panel. Police report obtained, both parties cited as cooperating. Scene photos requested from insured.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant reports headache, dizziness, and ringing in ears since collision. Diagnosed with concussion at urgent care visit. Claimant is not represented by an attorney at this time. Explained claims process and claimant's right to seek counsel. Medical records authorization sent to claimant for signature.

Entry 3: Vehicle inspection completed at repair facility. Damage consistent with reported side impact, including door intrusion and rear quarter panel deformation. Vehicle deemed repairable pending estimate review. Rental car coverage confirmed for claimant while vehicle is out of service.

Entry 4: Received signed medical authorization from claimant. Requested records from treating urgent care facility and follow-up neurology referral. Claimant reports symptoms persist and has reduced work hours due to light sensitivity and concentration difficulty. Advised claimant to keep a symptom and expense log.

Entry 5: Liability review in progress. Police report and witness statement indicate other driver failed to yield on left turn. Preliminary liability assessment favors insured at high probability. Bodily injury evaluation deferred until neurology records received. Next follow-up with claimant scheduled after records review.
